description: A composite group of three distinct panel types: a data table, two nanoindentation load-depth plots, and a 3x3 grid of electron-microscopy maps. The table lists hot-rolled 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni in RD (plus TD for 15Mn5Ni) against macro-hardness (VHN), nanoindentation hardness (GPa), YS (MPa), UTS (MPa) and elongation (%). Panels (a) and (b) plot Load (µN, 0-5000) versus Depth (nm, 0-200) for roughly ten curves each on the austenite (γ) matrix (labelled "Austenite") and on B2 stringers (labelled "B2"); both carry the annotations "Loading rate - 500 µN s^-1" and "Temperature - 298 K". Panel (b) contains an inset enlarging the low-load/low-depth region where step-like pop-in bursts appear on several B2 curves; no such bursts are visible in (a). The grid pairs (c,d,e) OIM/IPF maps, (f,g,h) phase+inverse-quality maps with legend γ (red) and B2 (blue) and a 10 µm scale bar in (g), and (i,j,k) ECCI micrographs of the indented regions: (c,f,i) show the γ-matrix, (d,g,j) and (e,h,k) two B2 stringers. Together the panels argue that γ and B2 have nearly identical hardness yet only B2 shows pop-in plasticity.

subfigures.description: Table of hardness and tensile properties of three hot-rolled alloys (28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni, 15Mn5Ni) with columns Alloy, Tensile Direction, Macro-hardness (VHN), Hardness (Nanoindentation) (GPa), YS (MPa), UTS (MPa), Elongation (%). Alloy 15Mn5Ni has two rows, RD and TD; nanoindentation hardness is given as γ: 6.7 ± 0.5 GPa and B2: 6.8 ± 0.3 GPa.

Nanoindentation load-depth curves for the austenite (γ) matrix: Load (µN) 0-5000 vs Depth (nm) 0-200, about ten coloured curves rising smoothly to ~150-175 nm depth; heading 'Nanoindentation', annotations 'Loading rate - 500 µN s^-1' and 'Temperature - 298 K'; no pop-in steps visible.

Nanoindentation load-depth curves for the B2 phase over the same axes (Load 0-5000 µN, Depth 0-200 nm), labelled 'B2', about ten curves; the loading segments are not smooth. An inset enlarges the low-load region and reveals clear step-like pop-in events.
OIM (IPF-coloured) map of the indented γ-matrix region; several large grains in blue/pink/purple/violet colours.
OIM/IPF map of a B2 stringer region with an IPF colour triangle (001, 101, 111) in the lower-left corner; grains in light blue, cyan and green.
OIM/IPF map of a second B2 stringer region; elongated grains in pink/magenta and pale violet tones.
Phase + image-quality map of the γ-matrix region, dominated by red with a few small blue patches; legend below: red = γ, blue = B2.
Phase + IQ map of a B2 stringer showing a broad blue (B2) band flanked by red (γ); black 10 µm scale bar printed at the bottom.
Phase + IQ map of the second B2 stringer, mostly blue (B2) with thin red (γ) regions on both sides.
ECCI micrograph of the γ-matrix region showing a few triangular indents at grain interiors and near boundaries.
ECCI micrograph of a B2 stringer with several triangular indents arranged along the stringer.
ECCI micrograph of the second B2 stringer showing a row of triangular indents within the banded structure.

observations.observation: The table reports nanoindentation hardness of the 15Mn5Ni alloy as γ: 6.7 ± 0.5 GPa and B2: 6.8 ± 0.3 GPa, i.e. nearly identical values for the two phases.
Macro-hardness values are 256 ± 5 VHN (28Mn0Ni, RD), 268 ± 5 VHN (28Mn5Ni, RD) and 375 ± 6 VHN (15Mn5Ni, TD); the 15Mn5Ni RD macro-hardness cell is empty/nil in the rendered table.

Yield strength and UTS increase in the order 28Mn0Ni (670 ± 12, 980 ± 10 MPa), 28Mn5Ni (730 ± 20, 1028 ± 20 MPa), 15Mn5Ni (1110 ± 8, 1260 ± 5 MPa RD; 1150 ± 5, 1261 ± 10 MPa TD), while elongation falls from 68 ± 3 % to 20 ± 2 % (RD) / 16 ± 2 % (TD).
Both load-depth plots use Load (µN) 0-5000 on the y-axis and Depth (nm) 0-200 on the x-axis, with maximum loads near 5000 µN reached at indentation depths of roughly 150-175 nm.
Panel (a) is labelled 'Austenite' and panel (b) 'B2'; both carry the annotations 'Nanoindentation', 'Loading rate - 500 µN s^-1' and 'Temperature - 298 K'.

The inset in panel (b) enlarges the low-load portion of the B2 curves (approximately 100-230 µN load and 5-18 nm depth) and shows staircase-like pop-in steps, whereas the austenite curves in (a) are smooth.
The phase + image-quality maps use the legend γ = red and B2 = blue, with a 10 µm scale bar printed in panel (g).
Panel (d) contains an IPF colour triangle labelled 001, 101 and 111, confirming that panels (c-e) are orientation (IPF) maps.
The ECCI micrographs (i, j, k) show triangular indents, several of them arranged in rows that follow the banded B2 stringer structure in (j) and (k).

The caption states that the load-depth curves were obtained from localised nanoindentation with 10 indentations for each phase, on the austenite matrix and polycrystalline B2 stringers of the 15Mn5Ni alloy, and that the average hardness values are listed in Table 3.
The caption and citing text state that nanoindentation pop-in events occurred at low loads during loading of B2 grains, while they were notably absent during indentation of the γ-grains.
The citing text reports reduced elastic moduli of 169-172 GPa for the γ-matrix and B2 phase; this value is not printed in any panel of the figure and is not confirmed by the images.

The citing text states the first pop-in loads in B2 grains fall in the range ~50-200 µN; no numeric value is printed on the inset of panel (b), so the image only shows that the events occur at low load.

The caption renders the austenite phase and the related designation as unrendered '??' placeholders ('load-depth curves of ?? and B2 phase', '??-matrix'), so the phase name must be inferred from the panel labels 'Austenite'/'γ' and the phase-map legend.

unreadable_items: caption phase names rendered as '??' placeholders (austenite / κ-carbide) in the supplied caption text
individual grain orientations in the OIM maps (c-e): the IPF colour key in (d) is small and partially readable
inset of panel (b): no numeric tick values other than 5, 10, 15 on the depth axis and 100, 200 on the load axis are comfortably legible; individual pop-in load values are not printed
macro-hardness cell for 15Mn5Ni RD in the table is blank/nil as rendered
